name: URLHaus
tagline: Malware URL threat intelligence sharing API from abuse.ch
description: URLhaus is a malware-URL intelligence platform operated by abuse.ch and Spamhaus. Its APIs support querying and downloading intelligence and submitting URLs directly used to distribute malware. Phishing sites and phishing-kit hosts are explicitly outside its submission scope.

auth.details: Auth-Key header required (abuse.ch Auth Key from auth.abuse.ch); free self-serve registration

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for authenticated not-for-profit use under fair-use and query-volume limits. High-value contributors may receive discretionary free access beyond those limits. Commercial or for-profit use may require a paid Spamhaus subscription.

rate_limits: No API-wide requests-per-minute quota is published. Database dumps should not be fetched more than once every 5 minutes; recent-URL and recent-payload queries return at most 1,000 entries.
use_cases: check if a URL is known malware or phishing
look up payload hashes linked to a malware URL
submit a newly discovered malware URL
